# 删除识别记录
##### 简要描述

- | 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| LogID | Interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">标记识别日志记录的ID，从0开始递增，-1表示删除所有识别记录</span> | 是 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceRecognition/1/DeleteRecord HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: ae47986a-4198-4f3a-97cb-be503d79a856
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 107

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<DeleteRecoRecordInfo>
<LogID>1</LogID>
</DeleteRecoRecordInfo>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 197

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceRecognition/1/DeleteRecord</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceRecognition/ChannelID/DeleteRecord` 

##### 请求方式

- put
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
{}

```
